newsitem.title: ITALY: Bertinotti says still no agreement on Italy budget.
newsitem.headline: Bertinotti says still no agreement on Italy budget.

text.p: Italy's Communist Refoundation party, which holds the balance of power in the lower house of parliament, said on Friday the government could not yet be sure of its vote to pass the 1997 budget.
Party leader Fausto Bertinotti told reporters after meeting Prime Minister Romano Prodi that his hard left party and the centre-left government were still not in agreement.
"There is still no accord. Our vote in the budget commission cannot be taken for granted," he said.
Bertinotti said both men spoke about a range of topics.

The budget commission is the key lower house body looking at the package before it is presented to the full chamber next Wednesday. It is due for final approval in the lower house by November 14. It then moves to the Senate and must be passed by the end of the year.
